problemStatement: Fresh Candidate v0.6 Scope calibration has five irreducible near-domain false activations at cutoff=1. They span accounting analysis, partnership agreement drafting, tax calculation, delivery re-dispatch procedure, and relationship-concept interpretation. All five become confirmed strong routes and therefore bypass Scope. Continuing to add domain/family-specific unsupported-target phrases would turn Evidence into an open-ended lexical patch layer. The shared missing abstraction is the user's question mode: generic information/how-to/definition/calculation/interpretation requests are not divination outcome or decision requests.

questionModeContract.purpose: Classify the speech act of the modern natural-language question before traditional-route arbitration. It does not select a route and does not infer any traditional LiuYao field.
outcomeOrDecisionSignals: explicit decision modality such as should/should-not or suitable/not-suitable
supported current target already extracted by Evidence v0.5
precedence: A concrete supported current outcome/decision target takes precedence over incidental information/procedure vocabulary.
A direct request to explain/define/list/calculate/analyze/write/perform a general method is information_request even when it contains a current22 domain noun.
If neither side is established, return undetermined; do not fabricate a route decision.
questionModeContract.arbitrationEffect: Arbitration v0.15 returns null for information_request before any strong/support route may be emitted. outcome_or_decision and undetermined continue through frozen Arbitration v0.14 behavior.
questionModeContract.scopeBypassEffect: No direct Scope-bypass code changes are allowed; informational questions are prevented from reaching confirmed strong arbitration instead.
